project.name: Lichen CoCulture_I 42 days
project.shortDesc: Co-culture experiment to investigate gene expression in lichenized and non-lichenized partners.
project.longDesc: Co-culture experiment to investigate gene expression in lichenized and non-lichenized partners. Focal pair was Xanthoria parietina and its algal symbiont Trebouxia sp. Additional pairings included Aspergillus nidulans (non-lichenized fungus), Cladonia portentosa (alternative lichenized fungus), Asterochloris sp (alternative lichenized algae), and Chlorella sorokiniana (non-lichenized algae). Cultures were grown on either 99:1 BMM:MEYE or Water Agar in garage incubator for 42 days.
